image_description: A close-up portrait of a Brown Pelican (Pelecanus occidentalis) facing forward against a plain, light blue-grey background. The bird features dark brown plumage on its neck and body, with a pale yellow/cream-colored head and crown. The most prominent feature is the long, massive bill with a visible gular pouch structure at the base. The eye is dark and distinct. The image crops the bird at the chest, excluding legs, feet, and full wing span.
